notes.text:
This update for systemd, systemd-mini fixes the following issues

Changes for systemd:

- Import commit 435c5779a785b4263b4dcacb70f50ef1cc3f9a7b (bsc#1267647).
- Import commit 7aa089f75b77b2db22941081c37b8917ea8d0dda (bsc#1261982).
- udev/scsi-id: check for invalid chars in various fields received from the kernel.
